lineage_clock_expressions.expression_sql: CAST(DATE_DIFF('HOUR', t.created_at, COALESCE(t.completed_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)) AS BIGINT) AS total_lifecycle_hours

CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('DAY', t.created_at, COALESCE(t.completed_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)) > 0 THEN ROUND(CAST(COALESCE(s.total_story_events, 0) AS DOUBLE) / DATE_DIFF('DAY', t.created_at, COALESCE(t.completed_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)), 2) ELSE CAST(COALESCE(s.total_story_events, 0) AS DOUBLE) END AS avg_daily_activity_rate
CAST(DATE_DIFF('HOUR', t.created_at, COALESCE(t.completed_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)) AS BIGINT) AS total_lifecycle_hours

CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('DAY', t.created_at, COALESCE(t.completed_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)) > 0 THEN ROUND(CAST(COALESCE(s.total_story_events, 0) AS DOUBLE) / DATE_DIFF('DAY', t.created_at, COALESCE(t.completed_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)), 2) ELSE CAST(COALESCE(s.total_story_events, 0) AS DOUBLE) END AS avg_daily_activity_rate

CAST(LEAST(100, GREATEST(0, (CASE WHEN base.is_completed AND base.delay_days = 0 THEN 40 WHEN base.is_completed AND base.delay_days <= 2 THEN 30 WHEN base.is_completed AND base.delay_days <= 7 THEN 20 WHEN base.is_completed THEN 10 WHEN CAST(base.due_date AS DATE) > CURRENT_DATE THEN 35 WHEN CAST(base.due_date AS DATE) = CURRENT_DATE THEN 25 ELSE 5 END) + (CASE WHEN base.response_time_days <= 1 THEN 30 WHEN base.response_time_days <= 3 THEN 25 WHEN base.response_time_days <= 7 THEN 20 WHEN base.response_time_days <= 14 THEN 15 WHEN NOT base.response_time_days IS NULL THEN 10 ELSE 5 END) + COALESCE(base.activity_score, 1) * 4 + (CASE WHEN base.complexity_score = 1 AND base.total_lifecycle_hours <= 168 THEN 10 WHEN base.complexity_score = 2 AND base.total_lifecycle_hours <= 336 THEN 10 WHEN base.complexity_score = 3 AND base.total_lifecycle_hours <= 720 THEN 10 WHEN base.total_lifecycle_hours <= 72 THEN 8 ELSE 5 END))) AS INT) AS lifecycle_health_score
CAST(DATE_DIFF('HOUR', t.created_at, COALESCE(t.completed_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)) AS BIGINT) AS total_lifecycle_hours

CASE WHEN NOT base.is_completed AND base.assignee_user_id IS NULL THEN 'backlog' WHEN NOT base.is_completed AND NOT base.assignee_user_id IS NULL AND COALESCE(base.first_assignment_timestamp, base.created_at) >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '1' DAY THEN 'newly_assigned' WHEN NOT base.is_completed AND NOT base.assignee_user_id IS NULL AND base.modified_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '7' DAY THEN 'active_development' WHEN NOT base.is_completed AND NOT base.assignee_user_id IS NULL THEN 'stagnant' WHEN base.is_completed AND base.delay_days = 0 THEN 'completed_on_time' WHEN base.is_completed AND base.delay_days > 0 THEN 'completed_delayed' ELSE 'unknown_state' END AS current_lifecycle_stage

change.definition: Compare absolute row delta, pred-only/gold-only key counts, and per-column L0/L3 mismatch and unmatched-occurrence counts. Shrunk means every comparable component non-increasing and at least one smaller, with no unavailable component. No sum or causal attribution.

aggregate.summary_rule: For ambiguous dates, any matching date is counted once at the best observed level. Otherwise any strict componentwise reduction is counted as shrink; unchanged requires all dates unchanged. Individual dates remain separate; no historical date is chosen.
